validator_non_stub.evidence: CandidateValidator implements real SHA-256 computation via _compute_candidate_hash() reading file content in 4096-byte blocks. Enforces explicit version with ValidationError if target_version missing. Validates artifact structure checking for {Family}{Version}Block.tsx and {Family}{Version}Schema.ts. comparator_non_stub.evidence: CanonicalComparator implements real comparison: _check_structural_diffs() compares file names against expected patterns; _check_api_changes() uses regex 'export\s+(default\s+)?(function|const|class|interface|type)\s+{export_name}\b' to detect missing exports and flags as breaking; _check_deviations() scans for UBRC markers (runtimeContext, theme, ils), theme markers (theme.primary, theme.secondary), and hardcoded brand markers (TutorialHub, tutorialhub, etc). Evidence dict populated with 10 fields. has_breaking_changes set based on API change severity.

manifest_sealed.evidence: PlacementManifest seal computed in _compute_manifest_seal() by: (1) converting manifest to dict via asdict(), (2) removing manifest_sha256 field, (3) serializing to JSON with sorted keys, (4) computing SHA-256 of JSON bytes. verify_manifest_seal() recomputes and compares. Seal includes manifest_id (UUID), timestamp, all file_paths, replacement_strategy, rollback_plan. Evidence JSON shows example seal 'manifest_seal_hash_def456'. Not a fake constant.
